title: Results Website: Data Feed Corruption from VoterTrack

lines.msg: Failed to fetch voter data feed from VoterTrack (LCBOE-VR01). Source API returned HTTP 500. Response body: 'Corrupted data stream: 1186 records in precincts 111 and 112 show 'Mail Ballot Received' without issuance record.'

Data feed from VoterTrack (LCBOE-VR01) contains 1,186 records with invalid state. 'Absentee Ballot Status' field set to 'received' for voters not in ballot issuance database. No record found in mail ballot application file (file: /data/issuance/20261029_0200.csv).

Frontend dashboard failed to render due to malformed JSON from data feed. Page load time: 47 seconds. Error: 'Invalid field type in 'absentee_status': expected 'issued', 'requested', or 'not_requested'; received 'received'.'
Data feed source verified: VoterTrack (LCBOE-VR01) — last sync: 10/23/2026 02:00 AM. No known system error on LCBOE-VR01.

System integrity compromised: Data feed from VoterTrack contains unverified edits made 10/29/2026 02:05–02:40. Audit trail shows no valid MFA prompt for user 'nruiz@lislevotes.example'. Source IP 10.100.45.12 not in authorized range.
Manual override required: Feed disabled from VoterTrack (LCBOE-VR01) to prevent further corruption. Results website now showing cached pre-incident data.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the data tampering in VoterTrack has reached the public-facing results website. IT and VSM must now validate the feed against offline sources and isolate the compromised interface.
